name: Stud Tower Defense [Alpha 1.21]
desc:
Bugs have reclaimed the Earth, forcing humanity to take refuge on fragile floating ships above the devastation. Ground colonies now cry out for salvation, summoning you to gather towers to stem the relentless swarm. 

UPDATES EVERY 2 WEEKS!


💸 Use code "30K" for rewards! 
❗ Next code at 40K LIKES!

🌀 Enter one of the platforms to descend to the ground below.
⚔️ Place towers to defend the village from waves of bugs!
🎉 Buy crates from the traveling salesman to unlock new cards, new defenders.

🪙 Premium players get double cash while in the Inner Ship AFK room!
🤝 Join the Stud TD community server for codes and announcements!

Since this game is currently in alpha, please report any bugs (or suggestions) to our community server. We would really appreciate your help!

Keybinds:
R: Upgrade
F: Switch Targeting
V: Sell
T: Toggle Increased Game Speed
1-9: Place Tower

Made by Vansmena and ChickenGOD4

scripts.title: BEST UPDATED
scripts.features:
Game Tab Features
Infinite Money: Take infinite money from a player (duo mode only).
Dropdown (select player), Button ("Take Infinite Money").
Give Money: Give money to a selected player.
Dropdown (select player), Input (amount), Button ("Give Money").
Spawn Unit: Spawn a unit at your location (owned units only).
Dropdown (select unit), Button ("Spawn Unit").
Mode Selection: Vote for a game mode (Nightmare, Hardcore, Normal).
Dropdown (select mode), Button ("Vote for Mode").
Auto Upgrade Units: Auto-upgrade a unit in a loop (start/stop).
Dropdown (select unit), Button ("Upgrade Unit").
Game Actions: Manage game actions.
Buttons: "Back to Lobby", "Play Again", "Start Endless Mode".
Lobby Tab Features
Equip Unit: Equip a unit (Any unit even u dont have them).
Dropdown (select unit), Button ("Equip Unit").
Buy Unit: Buy a unit (owned units only).
Dropdown (select unit), Input (amount), Button ("Buy Unit").
Buy Case: Buy a case (e.g., Box Of Goods).
Dropdown (select case), Input (amount), Button ("Buy Case").
Auto Open Case: Auto-open a number of cases.
Dropdown (select case), Input (amount), Button ("Open Case").
Map Selector: Select a map (e.g., Plains).
Dropdown (select map), Button ("Select Map").
Teleport to Places: Teleport to places (e.g., Inner Ship).
Dropdown (select place), Button ("Teleport").
Auto Farm: Auto-farm in Tutorial Mode (spawns units, upgrades, loops).
Toggle ("Enable Auto Farm"); spawns Archer/Gunner/Grappler, speeds up, upgrades, loops after defeating ArmoredSnail.
